theorem Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.actual_theta_nuclear_cost_limit.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {H : Type u_1}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [inst_2 : CompleteSpace H] {V : Type u_2}
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_4 : Module ℂ V] (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] H) (u v : ℕ → H),
  (Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun T =>
        ∑' (j : ℕ),
          ‖u j‖ *
            ‖(Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection (v j) -
                (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (v j)‖)
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
fun {H} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H] {V} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] e0 eF Theta u
    v hc =>
  Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.directed_source_nuclear_cost_limit (OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta)
    (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta)
    (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan_monotone e0 eF Theta)
    (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan_le e0 eF Theta)
    (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan_dense e0 eF Theta) u v hc

theorem DSourceKernel.sourceKernel_diagonal_series_limit.{u_1, u_2} : ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace X]
  {V : Type u_2} [inst_1 : AddCommGroup V] [inst_2 : Module ℂ V] (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure X) (b : X → ℝ),
  (∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) →
    ∀ (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ) (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu))
      (A : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu) →L[ℂ] ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (u v : ℕ → ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)),
      (Summable fun j => ‖u j‖ * ‖v j‖) →
        (∀ (F : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp ℂ 2 nu)), HasSum (fun j => inner ℂ (u j) F • v j) (A F)) →
          Filter.Tendsto
            (fun T => ∫ (x : X), DSourceKernel.finiteKernel nu b (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta T) A x x ∂nu)
            Filter.atTop
            (nhds (∑' (j : ℕ), inner ℂ (u j) ((OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (v j)))) :=
fun {X} [MeasurableSpace X] {V} [AddCommGroup V] [Module ℂ V] nu b hb e0 eF Theta A u v hc hfactor =>
  have he := fun T =>
    Eq.symm
      (HasSum.tsum_eq
        (DSourceKernel.finiteKernel_factor_series nu b hb (DSourceKernel.sourceSpan nu e0 eF Theta T) A u v hfactor));
  Eq.mpr
    (id
      (congrArg
        (fun x =>
          Filter.Tendsto x Filter.atTop
            (nhds (∑' (j : ℕ), inner ℂ (u j) ((OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (v j)))))
        (funext fun T => (fun T => he T) T)))
    (Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.actual_theta_source_series_limit e0 eF Theta u v hc)
